messages.subject: New publication using STAN to model hydroclimatic extremes
parts:
For anyone who is interested, please follow the link below to a paper using a hierarchical Bayesian framework (coded in STAN) to link the Pineapple Express to hydroclimatic extremes in Northern California. 

http://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1002/2014WR016664/abstract
